items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: Was he in the band before Al Washington?

ctx.x: Uh, he went to Los Angeles after I went there. Uh, uh, I know him good as a book too. Yeah. Cause he and Louis was on some of Louis first recordings.
Was he in the band before Al Washington? All right. I think so.
Hmm. That would be 31, I guess, I don't know what's in the band.
